A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Auto-Connect work. All 18 pages, including Appendices A-C, are readable and support comparison of the text, equations, tables, and figures.

before.justification: v2 reports original rigging and skinning experiments on Art-XL2.0 and ModelsResource, including quantitative comparisons, ablations, and qualitative results in Section 4 and Appendix B.

after.justification: v3 reports original rigging and skinning benchmark results, ablations, and qualitative evaluations in Section 4 and Appendix B. Retaining these results from v2 does not change their empirical status.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1-3.3 and Appendix A retain the same connectivity-preserving tokenization, RigFormer architecture, reward-guided DPO procedure, and geodesic-aware bone selection module.

E1.justification: Both versions use Art-XL2.0 and ModelsResource for rigging and skinning, with the same additional image-generated meshes, unseen-pose examples, and snake-like failure cases.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout Tables 1-6: rigging comparisons retain RigNet, MagicArticulate's hierarchical and spatial variants, and UniRig; skinning comparisons retain RigNet, NeuroSkinning, and HeterSkinNet with and without the proposed module.

E3.justification: Sections 4.1-4.2 and Appendix A.2 report identical dataset splits, augmentation procedures, metrics, model configurations, and training budgets. No evaluation protocol is added or revised.

E4.justification: The tokenization comparison, DPO ablations, data-augmentation analysis, and qualitative failure cases remain unchanged in Section 4.4 and Appendices B-C.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same point-estimate reporting. Neither reports evaluation seed counts, repeated-run uncertainty, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1-6 and qualitative findings are unchanged. For example, the proposed method's Art-XL2.0 rigging IoU remains 82.806% in Table 1, and its ModelsResource IoU remains 73.108% in Table 6.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and objectives in Equations 1-9 are unchanged, including tokenization, topology rewards, DPO weighting, and bone selection. No assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution statements, and conclusion retain the same claims about connectivity preservation, DPO-based topology improvement, and geodesic-aware skinning.

C2.justification: Interpretations of baseline failures, DPO benefits, and augmentation-driven generalization are unchanged. Appendix C retains the snake-like-data limitation, its explanation through training-data scarcity, and the same future directions.

D1.justification: Implementation details in Section 4 and Appendix A are identical, including optimizer settings, architecture dimensions, hardware, training times, and baseline checkpoint usage. The project link and access disclosures are also unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion and all 74 reference entries are unchanged. References shift across pages after the added acknowledgements, without changes to cited works or research positioning.

P1.justification: v3 revises author affiliation and contribution notes, replaces the preprint notice with NeurIPS 2025 information, and adds funding acknowledgements. Section 4.3 also drops 'Table' from 'Table 1'; the scientific narrative otherwise remains unchanged.

P2.justification: Expanded title-page notes and the new acknowledgements produce local spacing changes and reference reflow on pages 10-13. No figures or tables are added or redesigned, and the appendix pages are visually identical.

improvement.justification: v3 adds authorship and funding disclosures and updates publication information, while retaining the methods, evidence, reproducibility details, and limitations. These administrative additions and minor layout changes, together with the small Table 1 cross-reference defect, do not meaningfully alter the paper's overall quality.
